# rodrigodotdev/homebrew-tap

Homebrew formulae for [rodrigodotdev](https://github.com/rodrigodotdev)'s projects.

## warden

Safe, read-only MCP gateway that lets AI agents explore MySQL and PostgreSQL without
holding database credentials.

```bash
brew install rodrigodotdev/tap/warden
```

Source, documentation, and issues: <https://github.com/rodrigodotdev/warden>

## Do not edit the formulae here

Every formula in `Formula/` is rendered and pushed by its project's own release
workflow, from that release's published `SHA256SUMS`. A hand-edited formula survives
only until the next tag, which overwrites it.

To change `Formula/warden.rb`, edit `packaging/homebrew/warden.rb.template` in
[rodrigodotdev/warden](https://github.com/rodrigodotdev/warden) and cut a tag.
